action: Keep ResNet18 as the final model
reason: It has the highest verified Kaggle accuracy (94.63%).

action: Do not apply DogNose class weighting or oversampling
reason: DogNose validation precision and recall are already above 99%, and it is not overpredicted.
risk: Class weighting could reduce overall accuracy

action: If time permits, test a ResNet18-only multi-seed ensemble
reason: Two independently trained ResNet18 models on the same leakage-controlled split can reduce prediction variance without changing to the weaker ResNet50 architecture. The ensemble must improve labelled validation accuracy before test inference.
risk: Requires another ResNet18 training run and must be rejected if validation does not improve

action: For a retraining experiment, keep ResNet18 and evaluate one stronger regularisation change
reason: The main gap is generalisation rather than insufficient model capacity. Candidate changes include classifier dropout or MixUp, evaluated separately rather than together.
risk: Training augmentation can damage fine-grained feature boundaries

action: Retain black square padding and the verified preprocessing
reason: Previous geometry experiments did not justify changing the image transformation.
risk: Changing several pipeline components would make the result difficult to interpret

action: Do not force test predictions to match training class proportions
reason: The hidden test class distribution is unknown, so prior correction is not evidence-based.
